name: Lattice Library
oracle_text:
This enchantment enters with X study counters on it.
When this enchantment enters and whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of study counters on this enchantment.
blocked_sentences: When this enchantment enters and whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of study counters on this enchantment.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key that matches a spell whose printed mana cost contains {X} (the selector-side `x_in_mana_cost: true`), honoured by the trigger matcher so `nth: 1` counts only X spells for "your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `mana_cost`, but that is an exact printed-cost list match (has_printed_cost), so it cannot say 'any cost containing {X}'. `x_in_mana_cost` exists only in selector_keys / mana restrictions; the trigger matcher (triggers.py filter check) does not read it, so writing it in a trigger filter would load and fire on every spell
needs.closest_existing: mana_cost trigger filter; x_in_mana_cost selector key
